title: Sabbatic Year
sourceLines: -(A rest that reoccurs every seventh year)
-Israelite bondservants set free in Ex 21:2; De 15:12; Jer 34:14
-Creditors required to release debtors in De 15:1-6,12-18; Ne 10:31
-Ordinances concerning instruction in the law during De 31:10-13; Ne 8:18
-Punishment to follow violation of the ordinances concerning Le 26:34,35; with 26:32-41; Jer 34:12-22
